title: SAT Math Adaptive Calibration Learning Report & Learner Model Update (Session f54585d8-b881-433e-ab98-c6a4d24be003)
executiveSummary:
During the period 2026-08-06T21:20:00.060Z to 2026-08-06T21:25:35.734Z (Session f54585d8-b881-433e-ab98-c6a4d24be003), the learner completed a 15-item adaptive Math calibration set at Difficulty Level 2. The learner demonstrated high procedural accuracy (14/15 correct, 93.3%) and rapid pacing, spending an average of 19 seconds per item compared to an estimated target time of 111 seconds (82.9% under target time).

The single error occurred on item 66d07f42-e51d-485a-bd12-b3f774b26820 (skill: statistical-claims), where the learner expressed 'certain' confidence but incorrectly selected choice D, claiming 'no treatment was imposed' in a study where subjects were randomly assigned to desk types. This indicates a conceptual gap regarding the definition and scope of controlled experiments versus observational studies. Across the 10 items with explicit confidence ratings (9 'certain', 1 'medium'), 9 were correct, highlighting high self-trust that is well-calibrated computationally but susceptible to overconfidence on study design terminology. All skills evaluated in this single session are maintained as tentative mastery assessments pending multi-item and multi-session verification.
